These communications were reported in 11 of the 14 cases studied, as detailed in Table 1. [/page/3/Text/6] Direct communications of intent, threats or plans that made specific reference to suicide acts were reported in five cases. For example, on the day before he died one man told his aunt, "I am going to hang myself" and in the week before his suicide, another man said to his girlfriend, "If you're not going to come away with me I'm going to kill myself." [/page/3/Text/8] Direct communications of thoughts or feelings relating specifically to death or suicide were found in six cases. Thus one man who had become deeply involved in an online virtual-reality game said to his mother in the month before he died, "Life is not worth living without the game."
